_comment: Collision model of the robot cell. Base frame, meters, same convention as
calib_out/T_base_*.npy. EVERY NUMBER BELOW IS A PLACEHOLDER derived from the
existing session (table height from the cube's resting z, camera positions
from T_base_C*.npy). Measure the cell and replace them before trusting a
which requires all 232 already-executed poses to come out collision-free.

obstacles.name: table_top
_note: cube centre rests at z=0.0436 and the cube half-height is 0.0295.
links 0-1 are exempt: both sit on the J1 axis so their distance to the
table is a pose-independent constant (35.9 mm with the default radii),
which would otherwise pin the reported clearance and hide the real arm.
